description: A disk image's partition table and, for every filesystem on it, the filesystem header, a body file, a path list with inodes and a MAC timeline (The Sleuth Kit). A logical volume image with no partition table is read from sector 0.
covers: Allocated and deleted entries The Sleuth Kit lists for NTFS, FAT, exFAT, ext, HFS+ and APFS partitions. It reads no file contents, carves nothing, and does not open encrypted volumes (BitLocker, LUKS, FileVault) or volume shadow copies.
